title: Portugal digital nomad relocation - visa and tax residency unknowns
description: VE-03 seed (2026-09-09 visa audit): long-stay remote-worker relocation with an explicit multi-month date range and 'visa not applied yet' phrasing. Graduates the VISA-002 (digital nomad / tax residency) proposal from AREA_DEEP_DIVE_VISA_IMMIGRATION.md into the corpus as a coverage seed; the current pipeline correctly routes to ASK_FOLLOWUP because party size, purpose and per-traveler details are unknown. Tax-residency reasoning itself remains an open exploration item (VE-03 in the findings register).

inputs.raw_note: Client is relocating to Portugal as a remote worker, June 10 to December 10 2027. Needs help with the digital nomad visa application, visa not applied yet. Budget around 8 lakh for the whole stay.

assertions.message: A 'visa not applied yet' note must extract as visa required / not applied.
